acceptance_criteria.statement: All six fixture documents parse and the reaction/question payloads satisfy the frozen v1 contracts.
The atom mapping is unique, one-to-one and an exact inverse with full coverage of both sides.
Elements and net charge are conserved across the reaction.
No endo/exo request or selectivity claim exists anywhere in the fixture.
Method, basis, solvent, temperature, standard state, candidate cap, budget and tolerances are frozen before any real run.
The run spec records science/export/aggregate deadlines, one shared started_at, queue-accounting policy and the in-flight stop/export-window rules.
Reactant and product XYZ atom order is byte-stable and matches the declared atom_ids order exactly.
A real transition-state candidate has exactly one imaginary frequency with a mapped mode.
Bidirectional IRC reaches both specified endpoints with stable atom order.
Activation energy is computed under the frozen compatible conditions with explicit units.

activation_energy.reason: No energy or thermochemistry evidence exists yet.

endo_exo_selectivity.reason: Out of scope. The symmetric butadiene + ethene example cannot distinguish endo from exo, so no endo/exo request or claim is permitted.

path_connectivity.reason: No evidence exists yet; the static fixture cannot support the claim.

h4_closure.reason: H4 requires a real valid TS (one imaginary frequency with mapped mode), bidirectional IRC with both endpoints, comparable energies and honest negative cases. None exists; the budget timing basis is also unmeasured.

h4_rows.requirement: A real valid TS: one imaginary mode and a mapped mode.

h4_rows.requirement: Bidirectional IRC with both specified endpoints reached.
Endpoint geometry and bond-topology mapping prove the declared candidate path connects the specified endpoints.

limitations: No real energy, transition-state geometry or reference value is present.
The symmetric example cannot support endo/exo selectivity.
The reaction contract records the net transformation; it does not assert a single elementary step.
Other paths and the complete mechanism are not excluded.
No experimental rate, global minimum or general accuracy is claimed.
The budget timing basis is unmeasured, so H4 stays open.

scenario_result.reason: No real Diels-Alder transition-state, frequency, IRC or thermochemistry run has been executed. Static fixture construction is not a scenario result.
